posts.title: On enthusiasm
posts.description: Recently, I had a lovely (but unusual) experience at work: a student came up to me and enthused about the topic I had lectured on. You would think (and I would hope) that this kind of experience would be more common, but it isn’t. It made my week, though. I love enthusiasm. posts.title: Ethiojazz
posts.description: I’ve always been a fan of musical styles that are formed when people from different traditions interact. I’m sceptical that any musical tradition is ‘pure’ in that way, because people have alwayse met, listened to and been inspired by each others’ musical styles and traditions, so you can hear subtle or more overt influences in most styles of music.
